blocks.title: Hi! I'm Shiva
blocks.altText: Shiva Kakumanu, a photographer, standing against a field backdrop.
paragraphs: Hi, I’m Shiva. I’ve always been someone who likes understanding how things work—whether it’s software, systems at home, or everyday routines. I’m not drawn to shortcuts or surface-level answers; I prefer taking the time to understand the details and build things in a way that feels stable and intentional.

Professionally, I work with software, but my curiosity goes beyond code. I enjoy breaking down complex ideas into clear, usable pieces and writing them in a way that makes sense to real people, not just experts. On this blog, you’ll find technical posts with code snippets (Java, TypeScript, JSON), along with thoughts and lessons I pick up through daily problem-solving.

This space is also personal. I share travel experiences, observations, and small reflections—things that don’t always fit into neat categories but still shape how I think. I value calm environments, clean design, and systems that reduce friction rather than create it. I believe small improvements, done thoughtfully, add up to a better way of living.

I write here to think more clearly, to document what I’m learning, and to share ideas that might be useful to others on a similar path. If you appreciate honesty, structure, and writing that aims to be both practical and grounded, I’m glad you’re here.
